scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@wangmai/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,frontend,backend "npm run dev --workspace=@wangmai/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=@wangmai/frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=@wangmai/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@wangmai/shared && npm run build --workspace=@wangmai/frontend --workspace=@wangmai/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@wangmai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@wangmai/backend && npm run test:unit --workspace=@wangmai/frontend
